name: ouricinho
description: Ouricinho - a cozy autonomous 3D virtual hedgehog for desktop

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && npm run build:electron
scripts.build:appimage: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.build:deb: npm run build && electron-builder --linux deb --x64 --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dev:electron: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron dist-electron/main.js"
